title: Longtime special teams coach Frank Gansz Jr. dies at 64

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Longtime special teams coach Frank Gansz Jr. dies at 64
sources.description: Frank Gansz Jr., who spent decades as an assistant coach in the NFL, college football and multiple spring leagues, has died at the age of 64.
